limitations: One-dimensional classical elephant random walk at the critical memory p=3/4 only. The mean constants are Brownian path integrals without closed-form or certified numerical evaluation. Tail convergence is stated at profile continuity points; no convergence rate, second-order asymptotic, or joint rare-path limit for other statistics is claimed. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from general Brownian boundary-crossing theory under different terminology.
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
record_title: Critical elephant cover times: exact rare-path profiles and mean constants
